signature_features: Two R-95Sh turbojets in long nacelles alongside the fuselage, under the wing roots, with fixed round nozzles
Shoulder-mounted moderately swept wing with wingtip pods that split into speed brakes
Long pointed nose with laser rangefinder window, pitot boom, and a framed canopy over an armored cockpit
Ten underwing pylons typically carrying UB-32/B-8 rocket pods, bombs and outer R-60 rails
Short tall fin; trailing-link main gear retracting into the fuselage; Soviet two-tone sand/green camouflage with red star
